children: Cirrus Logic announced the acquisition of INVENTVM to add mixed-signal power management and audio IP and expand engineering capacity.
Acquired INVENTVM, a fabless semiconductor firm in Pavia, Italy specializing in mixed-signal power management and audio ICs.
Deal brings engineering expertise, intellectual property and regional presence to support expansion into new applications and markets.
Acquisition intended to accelerate product development and support Cirrus Logic’s long-term growth strategy.
Financial terms were not disclosed; company says transaction will not have a material impact on revenue.
